title: The Last Static Anew
author: Vesper Whitlock
blurb: Mara Oyelaran, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
